# Introduction

(Academic project)

In this HR analytics project, I built and improved multiple machine learning models to predict employee turnover.

I started with Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and KNN, achieving a baseline accuracy of 0.61. After hyperparameter tuning with GridSearchCV and balancing classes using SMOTE, model performance rose to 0.87.

The top predictors of attrition — including commute distance, age, and work environment — were translated into actionable retention strategies for the HR team.
